description: One small spiral notebook; "Daily Recitations", Zen Study Center, Chotokuin, Japan; copy of a letter to "Sybil" [sic] Sibyl Browne from Chabot, Dec. 20, 1967, which details the Japan trip, 1967 [original letter in MC - General Correspondence - "MC to Sibyl Browne"]; Membership List and brochure on The Alan Watts Tour of Japan, Sept. 26 - Nov. 6, 1967; California Living Magazine article on Alan Watts.
title: Japan trip
